cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(TagsXitFF LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(TagsXitFF WIN32 TagsXitFF.cpp)
target_compile_features(TagsXitFF PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
target_link_libraries(TagsXitFF PRIVATE comctl32 comdlg32)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(TagsXitFF PRIVATE /W4 /O2 /permissive-)
else()
  target_compile_options(TagsXitFF PRIVATE -O2 -Wall -Wextra)
endif()
